title: Coins in a Jar
story: Every Friday Selim puts spare coins into a glass jar. He wants a winter coat that costs forty pounds. This week he added three pounds from washing a car. His mother matched that amount, so the jar grew faster. Selim wrote the new total on a card. He is still short, but the goal is closer. He will not spend the money on snacks.
